group.instructions: The state is the name of a present someone gave or received, written by the user in any language (often Russian), possibly with typos or brand names. Choose the closest recognizable emoji representation of the gift item or experience. Use a literal depiction when available; otherwise use its function, what it produces, or a related object or activity. The exact object does not need its own emoji: appliances can be represented by the food or drink they make, services by the activity, branded products by their product type, and a gift certificate by what it buys. Prefer the gift contents over generic packaging. Among similar variants prefer a common general depiction. Use none only for an unknown, vague or abstract gift without a meaningful visual association. Choose the subgroup containing that closest recognizable representation, even when the gift itself is not a literal member of the subgroup.

price.instructions: Estimate the typical present-day retail price, in Russian rubles, of a typical version of the gift named in the state. Experiences and services count too. For money, gift cards and certificates with a stated amount, choose the option closest to that amount.
